content.text:
Fixed in `lib/plugin-override.js:85` — `buildRoutePrefix` now only prepends the separating `/` when the parent prefix doesn't already end with one, so `'/v1/'` + `'inner'` yields `/v1/inner` instead of `/v1//inner`.

Added a regression test in `test/route-prefix.test.js:244` alongside the existing trailing-slash test. `node --test test/route-prefix.test.js` passes all 27 tests.

Two notes:

- I did not empirically confirm the test fails on the unpatched code: doing so required temporarily reverting the source file, and the sandbox blocked the stash/restore command. The failure is straightforward from the old branch (`instancePrefix.endsWith('/') && pluginPrefix[0] === '/'` is false, so the `else if` prepends `/` unconditionally), but treat "fails before the change" as reasoned, not observed.
- Per COMPLEX.md, `lib/plugin-override.js` is not a listed hotspot and has no co-change partner, so no partner file was touched. `lib/route.js` already handles the `'/prefix/' + '/route'` case separately and needs no change.
